scripts.setup: pnpm install && cd backend && uv venv --python /opt/homebrew/bin/python3 && uv pip install -e ".[dev]"
scripts.build: ./node_modules/.bin/tsc -b packages/workspace packages/python packages/runtime && pnpm --filter demo build
scripts.test: pnpm test:backend && pnpm test:workspace && pnpm test:python && pnpm test:runtime
scripts.test:workspace: cd packages/workspace && node test/path.test.mjs && node test/records.test.mjs && node test/workspace.test.mjs && node test/staging.test.mjs && node test/concurrency.test.mjs && node test/storage-detection.test.mjs
scripts.test:python: cd packages/python && node test/protocol.test.mjs && node test/staging-integration.test.mjs
scripts.test:runtime: cd packages/runtime && node test/node-context.test.mjs && node test/agent-runtime.test.mjs
scripts.test:all: pnpm test:backend && pnpm test:workspace && pnpm test:python && pnpm test:python:browser && pnpm test:runtime
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
